contexts.text: Masses said in the Latin language. SE 5218.
In Heaven they have the Word, and other books; and in the Spiritual Heaven the writing is in... Roman letters... SE 5579. SE 5602. DMin 4790:end.

A revelation has been made by the Lord concerning Heaven and Hell; concerning the Last Judgment... concerning the spiritual sense of the Word... and concerning the state of man after death; and this fully and manifestly, so that anyone who understands the Latin language may know...
